{{Top|leg}}
"'''Initial observations of the Jannimak crash site on Dantooine'''" was a scientific paper written by [[Pordav|Doctor Pordav]], Disaster Response Lead for the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]],<ref name="Sporefall">{{TORcite|type=codex|[[Sporefall]]}}</ref><ref name="Glacial">{{TORcite|type=codex|[[Glacial Trespass]]}}</ref><ref name="Geothermal">{{TORcite|type=codex|[[Geothermal Disruption]]}}</ref> a subsidiary division of [[Galactic Solutions Industries]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|Galactic Sustainability Institute|exp=lots|type=codex}}</ref> In [[3622 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR updates|7.8}}</ref>, studying the phenomena occurring within the [[Jannimak crash site]] caused by [[Jannimak]]'s [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] of the surrounding environment, Doctor Pordav's team designated three distinct areas of the crash site in which the terraforming took different forms.<ref name="Wreckage">{{TORcite|type=general|Wreckage on Dantooine|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> Doctor Pordav described these areas and his initial observations in the paper.<ref name="Sporefall" /><ref name="Glacial" /><ref name="Geothermal" />
